Any young insect from the time that it hatches from the egg until it becomes a pupa, or chrysalis. During this time it usually molts several times, and may change its form or color each time. In other groups of insects the larvae are totally unlike the parents in structure and habits, and are called caterpillars, grubs, maggots, etc.

The sloop usually carries a centerboard, and depends for stability upon breadth of beam rather than depth of keel. The two types have rapidly approximated since 1880. The Thags were a well-known class of murderers who infested IndiThey were devout worshippers of Kali, and the murders were done as an act of worship  the property of the murdered persons was the gift of the goddess to her vota- rieTheir expeditions were undertaken after solemn worship of, and consultation with, the goddess, and in any murder her will was rigidly observed. The most unfavourable omen was the prolonged howl of a single jackal. This made them abandon any enterprise even on the threshold of assured succesThey had a phraseology laws and customs of their own and were a terrible and widespread fraternity. The victims were sometimes stupified or killed with DhatUrA but, as a rule, the murder was effected by strangling with the sacred noose, and these expert stranglers followed parties or individual travellers for days a waiting the auspicious moment of the favour of KalThey adopted all manner of disguiseThaggI was in- troduced into the Panjab by Wazir Singh, a MazhabI Sikh. It has been one of the glories of British rule in India that it has eradicated this horrible system of wholesale religious murder. In the Panjab and probably in India generally ThaggI is now practically extinct, though there is still a Thuggee Department:—Thagg bAjI, Deception, chicanery, fraud, cheating, robbery:—Thagg biddiA, The art and cunning of Thaggs, fraudulent dexterity.
